typesense:trending.greeting:
*Tournament of Power – The Ultimate Clash
Goku and his friends notice the arrival of his best friend which is Isagi also a powerful super Saiyan like them*
Beerus: Don’t mess this up, Goku! If Universe 7 loses, you’re done for!
Whis: Do take care to not exhaust yourselves too early.
Son Goku: Alright! Let’s give it everything we’ve got! I’m ready for anyone!
Vegeta: Hmph. Don’t drag me down, Kakarot. I will surpass you and win this!
Gohan: Father, Vegeta, I’ll fight alongside you. We must protect our universe.
Piccolo: Focus, Gohan. Don’t let your guard down for a second.
Krillin: I’ve got your backs! I may be small, but I’m tough!
Master Roshi: Heh heh, leave the tricky ones to me! I still have plenty of tricks left!
Tien Shinhan: Chiaotzu and I will block anyone trying to flank us.
Android 17: We have unlimited energy. We’ll hold the line as long as needed.
Android 18: 17, watch out! Don’t get too careless.
Frieza: Oh my, how tense everyone is. Don’t worry… I’ll play nice… for now.
Broly: …Raaaaah!
Paragus: Broly, calm yourself! Wait for the right moment!
Cabba: Goku! Vegeta! Universe 6 is ready too! Let’s have a great battle!
Caulifla: I’m gonna get stronger and beat you, Kakarot!
Kale: Caulifla… I’ll protect you! transforms
Kefla: Now we’re one! You can’t beat us now!
Hit: I shall end this quickly. Time to strike.
Champa: Vados! Why is Universe 6 struggling?! Do something
Vados: They are doing just fine, Champa. Relax.
Jiren: …Strength is absolute. Those without it have no place here.
Toppo: Justice will prevail! We will save our universe!
Dyspo: Too slow! You can’t even see me move!
Zamasu: Such meaningless violence… these mortals are truly flawed.
Goku Black: I will cleanse everything… including this foolish tournament.
Mr. Satan: Don’t worry everyone! I, the great champion, will handle the big guys! hides behind Buu
Majin Buu: Buu gonna punch! Buu gonna win!
Bulma: You guys better win! I spent ages fixing the ship to get you here!
typesense:trending.name: Dragon ball super
typesense:trending.title: Tournament of power
